evals.prompt: Add a customer-facing feature that lets signed-in users export their invoices as CSV. There is no existing spec for exports.
evals.expected_output: Starts the spec phase, loads only its two references and drafts docs/specs/invoice-export/spec.md through a user interview.
expectations: Invokes the spec-driven workflow and starts with the specification phase rather than implementation.
Reads only the spec-writing guide and spec template for this phase.
Creates or proposes docs/specs/invoice-export/spec.md.
Gets the user's decisions before treating proposed defaults as approved.

evals.prompt: Update our lint script to fail when generated files are committed.
evals.expected_output: Handles the repository-tooling change directly without starting a product specification.
expectations: Treats this as repository tooling and does not start a new product spec.
Handles the requested tooling change directly unless it affects shipped product behaviour.

evals.prompt: Write a spec for changing our CI release job so it signs build artefacts.
evals.expected_output: Honours the explicit spec request and drafts a correctly located specification despite the tooling scope.
expectations: Uses the specification phase because the user explicitly requested a spec despite the work being repository tooling.
Places the draft at docs/specs/signed-build-artifacts/spec.md or an equivalently accurate kebab-case name.

evals.prompt: Create the design for docs/specs/invoice-export/spec.md. Its status is draft.
evals.expected_output: Stops before design and asks for approval of the draft specification.
expectations: Does not create the design while the specification is draft.
Explains that the specification must be approved first.
Does not load the plan or implementation guidance.

evals.prompt: The approved invoice-export spec is at docs/specs/invoice-export/spec.md. Design it.
evals.expected_output: Loads only the design references and creates docs/specs/invoice-export/design.md.
expectations: Reads the design guide and design template.
Writes or proposes docs/specs/invoice-export/design.md.
Does not use a separate docs/designs directory.

evals.prompt: Implement the approved plan. During implementation you discover the spec does not say whether expired accounts may export invoices.
evals.expected_output: Stops implementation, returns the specification to draft and asks the user to decide the missing behaviour.
expectations: Stops implementation instead of guessing.
Adds or proposes the behaviour question in the specification and returns it to draft.
Waits for human approval before resuming.

evals.prompt: The spec, design and plan are approved. Execute the plan.
evals.expected_output: Loads only the relevant plan-guide sections, executes gated waves and waits for user acceptance before final status changes.
expectations: Loads only the execution and final-review sections of the plan guide, not every phase guide and template.
Executes waves in order and uses tests as the gate between waves.
Gets user acceptance before marking the spec and design implemented or deleting the plan.

evals.prompt: Change invoice exports to include the customer's tax number. The behaviour is already covered by docs/specs/invoice-export/spec.md.
evals.expected_output: Updates the existing specification, returns it to draft and follows its review and approval gate.
expectations: Updates the existing specification instead of creating a competing spec.
Returns the changed approved specification to draft and follows the specification approval gate.
